remediation.suggestion: Ask for user confirmation before installing agentation and prefer the project package manager detected from the lockfile.

content.value_statement: Teams need visual feedback during Next.js development. This skill installs Agentation and adds a development-only toolbar to App Router or Pages Router projects.
actual_capabilities: Checks package.json for an existing Agentation dependency.
Installs the Agentation package when it is missing.
Searches for an existing Agentation import or component usage.
Detects whether the project uses Next.js App Router or Pages Router.
Adds the Agentation component behind a development-only NODE_ENV check.
Tells the user how to verify the toolbar in the dev server.
limitations: Supports Next.js projects that use React 18.
Does not configure non-Next.js React applications.
Does not customize Agentation behavior or styling.
Requires package installation access in the target project.

use_cases.title: Add Feedback During UI Development
use_cases.description: Install Agentation so designers can annotate screens while developers run the Next.js app locally.

use_cases.title: Standardize Review Tooling
use_cases.description: Apply the same toolbar setup across App Router and Pages Router projects.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Project for Design QA
use_cases.description: Add a development-only annotation layer before a design review session.

output_examples.input: Add Agentation to my App Router project.
output_examples.output: Agentation is installed, imported in the root layout, and rendered only in development.

best_practices: Review package changes before accepting the installation.
Keep Agentation behind the NODE_ENV development guard.
Run the dev server after setup and confirm the toolbar appears.
anti_patterns: Do not render Agentation in production builds.
Do not add duplicate Agentation imports or components.
Do not use this setup in projects without React 18 support.

faq.question: What does this skill add?
faq.answer: It adds the Agentation visual feedback toolbar to a supported Next.js project.

faq.question: Does it support App Router?
faq.answer: Yes. It adds Agentation to the root layout when App Router files are present.

faq.question: Does it support Pages Router?
faq.answer: Yes. It adds Agentation to the custom app component when Pages Router files are present.

faq.question: Will Agentation run in production?
faq.answer: The documented setup renders Agentation only when NODE_ENV equals development.

faq.question: Does it require React 18?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill notes that Agentation requires React 18.

faq.question: Can it customize Agentation?
faq.answer: No. The skill only performs the basic installation and component setup.
